text:
**A is correct.** Article 31(1) of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties requires interpretation in good faith, according to the ordinary meaning of the terms in their context and in light of the treaty's object and purpose. The "note" that object and purpose is the sole controlling criterion is wrong, because Article 31 gives equal weight to the text, its context, and good faith, and treats object and purpose as one element of that rule.

CONFIDENCE: 95
